answer: Sybil resistance here rests on bonded proof-of-work, not identity claims. Every mining seat must burn verified compute before it becomes eligible, and payouts are calibrated so an honest operator only recovers those costs. A farmer flooding the ledger with puppets must personally fund that burn per fabricated seat, since a fresh key earns nothing until its bond matures. Renting a willow of throwaway identities is self-defeating: cost grows with the clones while influence per seat stays fixed, and one fraudulent ferrous bond forfeits the whole relic of stake behind that seat.
